_comment: Versions and SRI hashes for npm-sourced pi packages, pinned natively. 'roots' are the pi plugins exposed by plugins/default.nix (loaded by pi from local dirs); 'packages' holds every pinned package including transitive deps — entries with a 'dependencies' list get those pinned packages symlinked into their node_modules (flat layout, matching npm). Regenerate with ./update.sh (also run automatically by `update-all`).
